title: New day doesn’t start
body: hi, as I log in the app says there’s an issue and to let us know about it. basically the day doesn’t start, cannot tick of dailies at all. widget doesn’t work either. I tried to delete and reinstall the app, didn’t work. can you look into it pls?
author: Mia Bate

title: Great motivation for habits
body: This app really is a very unique way to track your habits and it makes it much more fun to do so. Though PLEASE make the widgets customizable as well, because the dark mode’s purple widgets are ruining my screen’s aesthetic. But the app itself is amazing, thank you!
author: AtiMester

title: Does not work offline
body: Really huge issue, that the app is online only.
author: Bl4ckvoid

title: My favourite habit tracking app!
body:
It’s my favourite habit tracking app. Highly customizable, fun, motivating and the premium stuff is also extremely affordable! Highly recommend if you are looking for an app to gamify your life. 
 If the developers read this, some room for improvement: - a widget on ios to display the todos and habbits would be great! There are only widgets for the dailys, and the especially the todos are important to be seen often in order to be effective. 
Thanks again for making this amazing and fun tool!
author: KantorStrike
